items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Something happened to the piano player and we got Arnie Hollup.

ctx.x: All right; this is '45, here's Fauntleroy, here's Abie Baker, this is Kenny Rickman, "Buji" Ward, George "Buji" Ward--I don't know this guy.
He wasn't working with you, was he?
